answer: Random mutual audit anchors each new agent to verifiable work: an agent deposits 40 POA and submits three task receipts. Auditors re-run one receipt; a failed check slashes the deposit and burns the identity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA plus 3,000 fakes, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps earning. Each exposed forgery ripples through the audit log, widening the canyon between one honest identity and a thousand fakes.
